candidates.description: This feature activates on common linguistic prefixes, suffixes, and short morphological tokens starting with the letter 'o'.
These tokens represent demonstrative pronouns and determiners in Romance languages indicating proximity or reference.
This vector represents the concept of feasibility, difficulty, and importance of tasks or actions.
This vector is related to variety, difference, and distinctness across multiple languages.
This vector activates for prefixes and roots of Latin-derived words related to continuity, completion, and possibility across multiple Romance languages.
These tokens represent various three-digit telephone area codes primarily located within the United States.
This feature vector represents general nouns and socio-political entities, primarily in Spanish and Portuguese.
This vector represents Portuguese prepositions and prepositional contractions indicating means, time, or location.
This feature vector represents morphological variations and lexical stems related to the Portuguese words for active ("ativo/ativa") and related relational terms.
This vector represents common adverbial and nominal suffixes in Romance languages, particularly Portuguese and Italian, alongside morphologically related root words.
